args.subject: Bedroom window - please confirm it now closes properly
args.body: Hello Elena, thank you for your message. Before we close the request for 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen, ZZ1 1ZZ, could you confirm that the bedroom window now closes and seals fully, and that the hinge parts the contractor needed to order have been fitted? If the window is still not closing properly, please tell us and we will follow it up with the landlord.

args.subject: Bedroom window repair - 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body: Hello Dorian, the tenant tells us the bedroom window work at 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen, ZZ1 1ZZ is done (the contractor, Richard, is said to be sending a report). Earlier she said parts needed ordering. Could you confirm the window repair is complete, and tell us whether there is any invoice or report we should have on file? Please also note that the gas safety record you forwarded on 10 September relates to a different property, so please resend the correct one if it is meant for this case.

args.reason: Waiting for Tenant and Landlord to confirm the bedroom window repair is complete, before closing.

args.summary: Landlord handled the window repair himself/with his contractor; the tenant says "All jobs was done" but it is unclear that the window itself is fixed. Asked tenant and landlord to confirm completion and follow-up set; not closing yet.
facts: Landlord inspected/arranged his own work (events 14, 16); no agency contractor instructed.
Contractor told tenant parts needed ordering (event 18).
Tenant says 'All jobs was done' and a contractor, Richard, will send a report (event 20).
No invoice or contractor report is on file.
conflicts: Forwarded gas safety record (forwarded-document.pdf, event 19) is for a different property and is irrelevant to the window; event 11 electrical report likewise unrelated.
Event 18 (parts to be ordered) vs event 20 (all jobs done): probably messages crossing in time, but 'all jobs' is vague.
missing: Confirmation the bedroom window now closes and seals
Landlord/contractor confirmation of completion and any invoice or report
options_rejected: Close now: completion is only vaguely stated and nothing confirms the window specifically.
Escalate: no real contradiction; one message to the tenant and landlord can settle it.
Wait only: a direct confirmation is cheap to ask for.
args.uncertainty: Unclear whether 'All jobs' refers to the window or to other jobs such as the electrical and gas paperwork.
